scope: Local authored controls; no live provider or model effects.

cases.ER01: Create one fresh bounded linked successor from an expired zero-effect run with original verified stores, stopped owner and current authority; original rows remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
cases.ER02: Original run/resume key and reference still identify old history; a fresh ordinary run key cannot bypass recovery.
cases.ER03: Reject absent, expired, mismatched or overlong recovery authority, stale current decision, changed plan, changed task version/revision/prose, foreign scope and unqueued/held/delivered/terminal/nonidle task.
cases.ER04: Reject any Core attempt including settled/unknown, lease, runtime attempt/effect/observation/receipt, host intent/record, workflow lineage or non-start step.
cases.ER05: Reject unsettled Core outbox, provider sends/progress and unapplied inbound observations; missing or replaced journal never becomes empty-history proof.
cases.ER06: Verify original descriptor identity, stopped process or PID reuse and absent endpoint; live, absent, replaced or ambiguous owner refuses.
cases.ER07: Concurrent identical recoveries and restart after lost commit reply return one successor; changed key/plan/authority conflicts without extra runs.
cases.ER08: Failure before successor commit rolls back pointer and lineage; original workflow and every failed step remain unchanged.
cases.ER09: Migrate schema 1 without changing run/step/lineage bytes or operation-key behavior; missing admission evidence refuses recovery rather than being backfilled.
cases.ER10: Successor uses normal run/resume and Core effect gates; a later hold or expiry prevents execution; no recovery operation is added to CLI/MCP.
